Name: Eemie's Flowers for Json Assets
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A conversion of Eemie's Victorian flowers to Json Assets
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's flowers from [SMAPI Seasonal Victorian Buildings and Flowers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891).  The buildings have already been converted to CP, but now you can use the flowers on their own as brand new objects!  These flowers are NOT crops, just decorative objects, like the Tub o' Flowers!  No need to worry about the crop limit, as it doesn't apply with these.  Check your crafting menu to create them.

This mod requires [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[JA] Eemie's Flowers' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
